title: Planning
description: What is available, what is being worked on, and what is research.
body:
MusicBrain grows in small steps: most ideas are built and tried right away. This page shows the state of things in three levels — **available now**, **working on now** and **research**. A research prototype is not a product promise.

For hardware we separate *design*, *produced prototype*, *physically tested* and *orderable* — a clean ERC/DRC or a fab package covers only part of design validation. Nothing is orderable yet.

items.title: Editor & simulator
items.markdown: Live at editor.musicbrain.nl, deployed 30 September 2026. No hardware or account needed.

items.title: Firmware 0.5.78
items.markdown: The latest released `.hex` for Teensy 4.1 (25 September 2026), flashed with PJRC Teensy Loader.

items.title: Reflex editor 0.2.0
items.markdown: Offline chain editor with MIDI/relay-state simulation, part of Reflex v0.1.

items.title: Cortex
items.markdown: The modular brain: playing, patch changes and simulator/Teensy behaviour, and integrating the busboard v3.1 hardware generation.

items.title: Reflex
items.markdown: The guitar effect switcher: the MIDI/footswitch controller and the relay loop boards.

items.title: Singing voice
items.markdown: A playable digital formant voice (FOF) that runs in the browser and on a Teensy. Working prototype; listening tests and a test on a physical Teensy are still open.

items.title: Material Bridge
items.markdown: A research instrument: four coupled resonators whose bridge contact remembers how hard you just played. Built for browser and Teensy; not yet tested on hardware.

items.title: State-Graph synthesis
items.markdown: Instruments whose sound depends on what happened before — Material Bridge is the first one.

items.title: Instrument Lab
items.markdown: Analog and hybrid voice circuits, such as voice tiles.

items.title: Expressive control
items.markdown: MPE, patch morphing and richer voice workflows — partly implemented, each with its own status.

items.title: More ways to play
items.markdown: Alternative controllers for Cortex: trackpad, joystick, a rolling-ball 3D controller, and your phone — or a few old phones — running the controller app, which already works.

items.title: External control surfaces
items.markdown: Pairing with devices such as the Melbourne Instruments Roto-Control, and MPE compatibility for controllers like the Expressive E Osmose.

items.title: Korg logue SDK
items.markdown: Looking into the logue SDK as a way to run MusicBrain DSP on Korg's platform.

config.markdown: *Versions:* the firmware source is at 0.5.94; builds after 0.5.78 are development snapshots, not downloads. The day-to-day list of work is the [backlog on GitHub (NL)](https://github.com/MarkWestbroek/MusicBrain/blob/main/doc/BACKLOG.md).

config.markdown: Each board on its way from idea to produced board.
